evidence.limits: whisper.srt not available at coding time; speech coded from burned-in phrase captions (hook at 4 fps, later at 1 fps, so some words may be missed). The podcast name is not visible. The before-and-after photos at 1:00 to 1:03 carry another business's logo ('יאללה רזים'); who made them is inferred from the caption wording 'חלק שלחו לי תמונות'. The whiteboard handwriting is only partly legible. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: Why a new business should run a free 'pilot' for a group of people: a hamburger-restaurant example, the whiteboard steps of experience, confidence and social proof, and his own first free group (1900 shekels would have been 19,000 for 10 people).
audience: aspiring and early-stage business owners (service businesses, coaches)
caption_vs_video_note: Caption states the pilot advice and lists the three reasons (experience, confidence, social proof) as numbered text; the video presents the same three reasons on a whiteboard and adds the burger example. The caption is the better summary of the video.

opening.first_frame: Matan in profile, backwards cap and a pink striped shirt, blue curtain and purple light, looking down-right with his hand moving; caption 'בא אליך מקעקע'.
opening.s0_1: Colour shot with caption 'בא אליך מקעקע' (0 to 0.5 s), then 'ואומר:' as he puts his hand to his neck.
opening.s1_3: At 1 s cut to a black and white frame, quoted yellow captions: 'שומע אחי?' (1.25 s) and 'אני אעשה לך קעקוע!' (1.75 to 2.5 s).
opening.s3_5: Another quote 'אבל בחיים לא עשיתי למישהו קעקוע' (2.75 s) with an inset video of a finished arm tattoo from 3 s, then 'ויכול להיות שזה ישאר לך לכל החיים' (4.5 s).
opening.visual_hook: A hypothetical story of a tattoo artist offering a free first tattoo, with a b&w quoted look and an arm tattoo inset.
opening.spoken_hook: Spoken from 0 s, matches captions: a tattoo artist says 'שומע אחי, אני אעשה לך קעקוע, אבל בחיים לא עשיתי למישהו קעקוע' (0 to 4.4 s), 'ויכול שזה יישאר לך לכל החיים' (4.4 to 5.9 s); machine transcript
opening.text_hook: בא אליך מקעקע ואומר: / שומע אחי? אני אעשה לך קעקוע!
opening.payoff_promised_at_s: about 7 to 9 s ('יש אנשים שיגידו: אם הקעקוע יהיה בחינם! ... פיילוט')
opening.first_sentence_standalone: yes: a hypothetical about a tattoo artist offering a first tattoo makes sense alone, but its link to business only arrives at 7 to 9 s
opening.works_without_sound: yes: captions with quote colours and the inset carry the story

visual.subject_placement: Matan seated at left side, in profile to a person off camera (the interviewer or host), whiteboard at the lower centre during the explanation; captions at the middle of the frame (about 55%).
visual.setting: Podcast studio with a blue curtain backdrop and purple key light, a table with markers and a whiteboard, a paper cup.
visual.lighting: Saturated blue background with a purple-pink key light; some shots in black and white.
visual.color_contrast: Pink shirt against deep blue curtain; white captions with yellow for quoted speech and green for 'לקוחות בחינם'.
visual.props_and_gestures: A whiteboard with numbered items in red and green writing, marker pens (hands of another person write), open palms, finger to temple; hand circles items on the board.
visual.supporting_footage: An arm tattoo video (3 to 6 s), a street photo of Dizengoff Square (13 to 14 s), a burger-and-fries stock image with a 'חינם!' burst (16 to 17 s), a crowd queue (51 to 54 s), a small group class in a gym (58 to 59 s), before and after body photos with a diet-coach logo (60 to 63 s), cash stack graphic (22 s).
visual.visual_progression: 0 to 6 s b&w quote and tattoo inset; 6 to 11 s colour, he points to the board; 12 to 22 s burger example with stock images; 23 to 50 s whiteboard steps ('נסיון', 'ביטחון', 'הוכחה חברתית'); 51 to 59 s crowd queue and gym class inserts; 60 to 63 s before/after photos; 64 to 80 s calculation 1900 and 19,000 and the final claim.
visual.cover_matches_video: yes: cover is a black and white talking frame in the same look as the b&w quote shots, with the quoted caption 'אני בעל עסק?' (the exact second is not on the sheets I saw)
visual.ui_interference: Captions at about 50 to 55%, inside the safe area; insets at 60 to 85% sit in the bottom 35% zone.

editing.edit_function: Information and illustration: the editor cuts between profile, front and whiteboard angles, inserts images for each example (square, burger, queue, gym class) and colours the quotes; the b&w shots mark hypothetical quotes (e.g., what the customer would say).
pacing_changes: t=0 to 6s: b&w and colour alternating, inset tattoo
t=12 to 22s: stock images every 1 to 2 s
t=23 to 50s: whiteboard build, cuts every 3 to 5 s
t=51 to 63s: image inserts every 1 to 3 s
t=64 to 80s: slower cuts, whiteboard numbers
editing.ending: Last 3 s: caption '(לא רק מעצמנו) אלא גם מהעולם: יש פה משהו!' while he gestures; ends on his profile shot with the board visible.
editing.rewatch_reasons: Interpretation: the whiteboard steps are easy to review, but the end is a mid-flow sentence, no loop.

sound.delivery: Machine transcript: continuous conversational speech from 0 s, gaps under 1 s, ending at about 81 s; at 29 to 31 s the transcript stutters 'רא... רא... תי' (a verbal slip on 'הוכחה', unclear); 'מה? 90 שקלים?' at about 72 s is probably a mishear of the 19,000 figure (captions are the reference for numbers).
sound.sfx: inferred: whoosh on the whip transition at 54 s
sound.sync: Captions follow his speech, each image appears on the word naming it (e.g. 'ברחוב דיזנגוף' shows the square; 'המבורגרים בחינם!' shows the burger); the circles on the whiteboard land on the item being named.

text.colour_coding: White by default; yellow for hypothetical quoted speech ('שומע אחי?', 'למה הם עשו את זה?', 'הם הפסידו כסף!', 'אני אגבה כסף?'); green for 'לקוחות בחינם'; red for 'לא!' and 'אפקט המתחזה'; a '3.' at 35 s starts the third reason.
text.placement: Centre of frame, about 50 to 55%, one or two lines.
text.style: Bold sans-serif Hebrew, black outline, no box; whiteboard handwriting in red and green.
text.density_and_read_time: 2 to 5 words per caption, changing every 1 to 2 s; easy.
text.language: Plain talk with hypothetical dialogue ('בא אליך מקעקע ואומר:', 'אחי'); named concepts like 'אפקט המתחזה' (impostor effect) and 'הוכחה חברתית'.
text.caption_structure: A long post: advice 'pilot' with a quoted objection ('אבל מתן… למה שאני אעבוד בחינם???'), three numbered reasons (experience, confidence, social proof) and a closing line that customers might continue and buy. No CTA, no hashtags.
text.rtl_notes: Hebrew RTL correct; '₪1900' and '₪19,000' render with the sign next to the number; hyphen and ellipses sometimes on the wrong side ('...ובערך').

story.setup: A tattoo artist offers a free tattoo although he has never made one; people would say 'let me run away'.
story.stakes: Why a new business should work for free.
story.progression: Hypothetical, then the pilot term; burger example with a free burger restaurant opening on Dizengoff; whiteboard of three reasons: experience, confidence (the impostor effect), social proof; crowd queue example; his own first group class and before/after photos; numbers 1900 versus 19,000.
story.payoff: The claim that a free pilot returns experience, confidence and proof.
story.resolution: Closing principle, machine transcript (about 73 to 80 s): test on people until you get approval not only from yourself but from the world; the very last words (about 80 to 81 s) are unclear in the transcript.
friction_points: t=0 to 7s: tattoo hypothetical is unrelated to business until 8 s (interpretation)
t=64 to 77s: the 1900 and 19,000 calculation uses little visual support (interpretation)

engagement.comment_notes: Sample of 28 comments, not representative. Mostly praise ('תותח', 'איש חכם מאוד שווה להקשיב לך') and business owners sharing their own pilot experiences; one remarks the pilot did not work for her, another asks how to reach them.

conversion.proof: His own pilot with a group and before/after pictures.
conversion.objection_handling: The 'why work for free' objection is voiced in the caption and answered with three reasons.

pair_match.notes: n/a (top Reel, no pair in dossier)

rights_and_privacy: Own event footage of a small class with participants and before/after photos of clients (faces visible, a third-party diet business logo on the pictures); a tattoo video, burger stock image and a crowd queue video that look third-party; blurred names absent.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: a humorous opening hypothetical, a visual whiteboard with three numbered reasons, and a concrete personal pilot with numbers make a practical lesson for business starters.
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: the tattoo opening does not state the topic, no CTA, and the end is abrupt; the visual style (whiteboard, stock inserts) is similar to his other Reels.

standout_moments.what: Black and white colour change marks a hypothetical customer quote
Real tattoo-arm inset used as the visual for the 'tattoo artist' hypothetical
Burger stock image with a red 'חינם!' burst as the free-pilot example
'.3' starts the third numbered reason on the board
'₪1900' then '₪19,000' appear as the pilot value numbers
